papers.title: Forecasting Scientific Progress with Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Current AI systems demonstrate limited capability in predicting scientific progress, showing inconsistent performance across domains and systematic overconfidence in forecasts.

papers.title: SEGA: Spectral-Energy Guided Attention for Resolution Extrapolation in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract: SEGA improves high-resolution text-to-image generation by adaptively scaling attention across RoPE components based on spatial-frequency structure during denoising steps.

papers.title: Unsupervised Process Reward Models
papers.abstract: Unsupervised reward models eliminate the need for human annotations by leveraging language model next-token probabilities to identify erroneous reasoning steps and improve policy optimization.

papers.title: AutoRubric-T2I: Robust Rule-Based Reward Model for Text-to-Image Alignment
papers.abstract: AutoRubric-T2I automatically generates and selects explicit rubrics to guide Vision-Language Model judges for text-to-image generation, achieving high-quality reward signals with minimal annotation.

papers.title: Forecasting Downstream Performance of LLMs With Proxy Metrics
papers.abstract: Proxy metrics based on token-level statistics from expert-written solutions provide more reliable model performance forecasting than traditional loss-based methods across development stages.

papers.title: LoREnc: Low-Rank Encryption for Securing Foundation Models and LoRA Adapters
papers.abstract: LoREnc secures foundation models and low-rank adapters through spectral truncation and compensation techniques that prevent unauthorized model recovery while maintaining performance.

papers.title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
papers.abstract: Efficient agentic reasoning requires decomposing decision-making into three systems—simulative reasoning, self-regulation, and reactive execution—enabling controlled planning that reduces token usage.

papers.title: Rule2DRC: Benchmarking LLM Agents for DRC Script Synthesis with Execution-Guided Test Generation
papers.abstract: Rule2DRC introduces a large-scale benchmark for DRC script synthesis with 1,000 rule-to-script tasks and 13,921 evaluation layouts, along with SplitTester for program selection.

papers.title: "I didn't Make the Micro Decisions": Measuring, Inducing, and Exposing Goal-Level AI Contributions in Collaboration
papers.abstract: CoTrace framework analyzes goal-level contributions in human-AI collaboration, revealing that while models account for 11-26% of goal-shaping, they significantly influence concrete requirements.

papers.title: Platonic Representations in the Human Brain: Unsupervised Recovery of Universal Geometry
papers.abstract: Self-supervised encoding of brain data reveals shared neural geometry across individuals through geometric transformations without paired data, supporting universal representation hypothesis.
